exposure: fluid administration in the delivery room
urinary volume at first catheterization after delivery
outcome: Urinary volume at first catheterization after delivery
cohort: 91 women with PUR exceeding 400ml during the first urinary catheterization after delivery
finding: Delayed management of urinary retention can lead to bladder overdistension and persistent postpartum urinary retention.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of persistent PUR.
